title: Response to the Request for Information

sections.title: Company Profile and Capability Overview
sections.instruction: Answer the notice's company profile and capabilities request.

sections.title: Company Information
sections.instruction: Company name, address and website; point of contact name, phone and email; SAM UEI and CAGE code; business size and socio-economic designations. State only what the notice asks for.

sections.title: Corporate Capabilities
sections.instruction: Core competencies and why they are relevant to the project scope, in the agency's own terms. Brief.

sections.title: Relevant Technical Capabilities
sections.instruction: One subsection (level 2) per major scope area in the draft requirements, in the agency's order. For each: the requirement area it answers, the team's experience, the technologies and responsibilities, and a measurable result. Replace this line with the areas for this solicitation.

sections.title: Relevant Past Performance
sections.instruction: The number of similar projects, within the look-back period, that the notice asks for. For each: customer, contract number, total value, period of performance, client reference contact, the team's role, what was done and the result.

sections.title: Project 1
sections.instruction: Customer, contract number, total contract value, period of performance, client reference, the team's role, work performed, technologies, measurable results.

sections.title: Project 3
sections.instruction: As Project 1. Remove if the notice asks for fewer.

sections.title: Recommended Approach and Resource Considerations
sections.instruction: Preliminary recommendations the notice asks for (for example equipment, reclamation, level of effort). Non-binding: say 'can' and 'typically', state assumptions, and make no price or schedule commitment.

sections.title: Recommended Solution
sections.instruction: Recommended technologies or equipment for the agency's environment, and why.

sections.title: Preliminary Level of Effort
sections.instruction: Rough order of magnitude only: projected labor hours or roles with the assumptions behind them. Not a quote.

sections.title: Teaming and Delivery Structure
sections.instruction: Any joint venture, mentor-protege arrangement or major subcontracting the team anticipates.

sections.title: Proposed Team Structure
sections.instruction: Who is on the team and in what relationship.

sections.title: Division of Responsibilities
sections.instruction: Which party covers which part of the scope.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: A short summary of the team's qualifications for the agency's objectives.

sections.title: Feedback on the Draft Requirements
sections.instruction: Only if the notice invites comments: what to clarify, change or add in the draft requirements, and why.

sections.title: Questions for the Agency
sections.instruction: Only if the notice invites questions. Also log them in questions.md.
